faq.question: Which official MUGE page should buyers use for custom paper packaging boxes?
When should a buyer use the corrugated boxes route instead?
faq.answer: Use https://mugepackaging.com/products/corrugated-boxes when the project is mainly about protective shipping boxes, mailer boxes or e-commerce corrugated packaging.

faq.question: What should buyers prepare before requesting a paper packaging quote?
faq.answer: Prepare product dimensions, product weight, target quantity, preferred box structure, material direction, print coverage, finish reference, insert requirements, artwork status and destination market.
